_readme: Starting catalog (REQ-1.10). Recipes written by the Forkful team in our own words. To add one: copy an entry, give it a unique slug, and run `npm run db:seed`. Allowed units are listed in scripts/lib/seed-validate.mjs. quantity is a number (0.5 for 1/2), or null for 'to taste'. quantity_max is only for ranges like 2-3. raw_text is optional; the script builds it if missing. Photos must be ours or freely licensed (BR-12); leave photo fields out until then.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Pasta
recipes.description: A quick weeknight pasta with garlic, butter, and parmesan.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Melt the butter in a large pan over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant but not browned.
Add the pasta to the pan with a splash of the pasta water and toss to coat.
Stir in the parmesan and parsley, adding more pasta water if it looks dry. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Classic Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy breakfast pancakes from pantry staples.
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ones and stir just until combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly greased pan over medium heat. Pour about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on top, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: Leftover rice turned into a fast one-pan dinner.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Cook the chicken until no longer pink, about 5 minutes, then move it to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil. Pour in the eggs and scramble until just set, then push them to the side.
Add the peas and carrots and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce and sesame oil, and toss. Top with green onions.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tacos
recipes.description: Smoky black bean tacos with a quick lime slaw.
steps: Put the beans, cumin, paprika, and water in a saucepan over medium heat. Simmer for 5 minutes, mashing about half the beans.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for about 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with beans and top with the slaw.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Soup
recipes.description: A smooth tomato soup made with canned tomatoes.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes with their juice and the broth. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the basil and blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream if using, and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and both sugars until fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Mix in the flour mixture on low speed, then stir in the chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough 2 inches apart. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes until the edges are golden.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes before moving to a rack.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Crisp vegetables, olives, and feta with a lemon-oregano dressing.
steps: Combine the cucumber, tomatoes, onion, and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano, then pour over the salad and toss.
Top with the feta, in one piece or crumbled.

recipes.title: Beef Chili
recipes.description: A hearty one-pot chili with beans.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Brown the beef, breaking it up, then drain off extra fat.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, chili powder, and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, beans, and broth. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat.
Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring now and then. Season with salt.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
recipes.description: Moist banana bread for overripe bananas.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Mix the bananas and melted butter. Stir in the sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the mixture and stir, then mix in the flour.
Pour into the pan and bake for 55 to 65 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack.

recipes.title: Chickpea Curry
recipes.description: A creamy coconut curry with chickpeas and spinach.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk, and tomatoes. Simmer for 15 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, and season with salt. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Roasted Vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss all the vegetables with the olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Spread in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats
recipes.description: No-cook oats you make the night before.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, and honey together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
Top with berries before serving.
